represents: Microsoft Entra ID directory audit activity in one tenant: application registration administration by platform engineers and a Terraform (azuread provider) service principal -- GitHub Actions federated identity credentials from the APPROVED issuer token.actions.githubusercontent.com with repo + environment / branch subjects (added, appended, retired), client-secret rotation, certificate upload, redirect URIs, new apps and service principals; user consent and admin (AllPrincipals) consent to sign-in-only scopes (openid / profile / email / User.Read), the matching delegated permission grants, a least-privilege application permission (Sites.Selected); plus the surrounding group, user, password, PIM role activation and Conditional Access changes. Template weights deliberately over-sample the activity adjacent to the rules in adjacent_to (and their documented false-positive classes), so a rule's hits and rate_per_10k on this slice are corpus figures, not a production rate.
provenance: synthetic; shapes from the Azure Monitor diagnostic-setting AuditLogs schema and the Entra audit-activity reference (activity names, categories, loggedByService, modifiedProperties conventions incl. JSON-quoted values and 'Included Updated Properties'), and this repo's TRR9013 / TRR9017 fixtures (PascalCase FIC newValue, ConsentAction.Permissions text). Tenant and object ids are random GUIDs; Microsoft Graph appId is the public first-party id; users are role handles at example.com; addresses RFC 5737 (203.0.113.0/24 corporate egress, 192.0.2.0/26 home users).
